messages:
emma: Quick sync — final smoke checklist for GA tomorrow. I'm blocked on two billing items and one SLO wording question. Can we triage? :hourglass: 

luis: Which billing items exactly? pricing page? metering? invoices?

emma: Two things: (1) public pricing page still shows per-call units; finance wants per-token numbers + examples, (2) trial credits metering — we need to confirm free-tier quota enforcement on Dedicated.

tracy: I can pick up the pricing page copy. PR is ready but needs numbers: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/432 

emma: Thanks — want the numbers by 08:30 PT so legal can sign off.

paul: About the SLO: Product wants "99.9% uptime" in the doc. We need to be explicit what that means (availability of API vs latency tail). Suggest: define SLOs as 99.9% of requests return 2xx within p95 latency X.

luis: +1. Also call out acceptable error budget and rollback policy.

emma: Proposed SLO text: ```Hosted API SLO: 99.9% of user requests return 2xx within p95 latency <= 300ms, measured at the gateway level (user-facing). Error budget: 43.2m/month.``` Is that acceptable?

paul: That looks fine but we should separate model-quality degradations (generation quality) from infra availability in docs. Different SLIs.

tracy: Agreed. I'll add two SLIs in the monitoring doc: infra SLI (2xx + latency) and quality SLI (prompt eval pass rate on smoke prompts).

emma: Oncall routing question — who gets alerted for model degradations vs infra incidents?

luis: Proposal: infra alerts -> eng-oncall (eng-sre), model degradation alerts -> eng-ml first, with auto-escalation to eng-sre after 15m if CPU/GPU anomalies detected.

paul: We also need a runbook link for hypercare (first 72h) and a pager rotation plan. Can ops own the hypercare schedule?

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout to 5% at 09:00 PT, full rollout at 10:00 PT if no regressions. See: https://ci.redwood/integrations/rollout/789 :robot_face:

tracy: I'll update dashboards: add latency heatmap, token/sec ingestion, 2xx rate, and prompt-eval pass trend. Putting the SLI config in alerts/SLIs.yaml now.

emma: OK owners: pricing copy = tracy, metering enforcement = luis, SLO wording + runbook = paul. Please comment in thread when done. Final signoff target 08:45 PT so we can proceed with canary at 09:00. :thumbsup:
